findings.description: Pending positive callbacks require the captured dialog identity and revision plus visible window attachment. Cancel/configure/detach revoke that revision; an old dismiss cannot clear a replacement dialog.

verification: Read the production dialog callback and cancellation ownership paths.
Reviewed real API35 queued cancel/detach/replacement red-to-green cases and four profiles with 32 passing cases.
Viewed actual landscape large-text calling and portrait large-text idle screenshots; primary actions remain readable and visible.
limitations: No independent rerun of the complete Android build; reviewed frozen source and recorded device-run evidence.
API19 UI, physical device, active Core SOS overlay/clear, SIP and physical actuator qualification remain outside this scope.
